features: Correct installed-profile count and current-user gamer picture
Native Guide sign-in, sign-out and profile-card actions
Correct earned-achievement flags; preserve original achievement spacing and only inset selection highlight below divider
Retain thin menu dividers; center-peaked account/menu highlights and bounded Xbox Live info text
FTP moved to System/Computers with displayed editable persistent username/password
Audio device priming, startup fade and exit fade/silent drain

profile.count: Only standard public STFS package magic/content-type header, deduplicate nonzero profile IDs across mounted devices; no Account/GPD payload or credentials read. Unknown stays unknown.
profile.gamer_picture: Current-user LocalGamerTile type4, GamerTile type2, keyed type9 fallback. Preserve last good picture on transient read failure; clear on identity change.

guide.guards: Captured active user/XUID rechecked; busy and stale identity rejected. No custom sign-out or profile fallback.

profile.cache: Dashboard-owned monotonic profile revision tracks identity/snapshot changes while retaining card focus

layout.scope: Original icon size/spacing, grid, header and scroll arrows retained. Only focus rectangle inset; no tab rescaling/reflow.

visuals.highlight: alpha=132*sin(pi*(column+0.5)/width)^2, brightest middle and fades both sides
visuals.reference: Uploaded video frame 0265 near22:00 confirms central brightness; actual achievement photo/video used for geometry
visuals.dividers: Normal and selected menu/library rows plus all three FTP controls retain thin dark/light dividers
visuals.account_inner_band: Alpha scanline gradients replace inner hard line; rounded outside frame retained
visuals.live_text: Word wrapped inside information column, 28px beyond button column and bounded before footer

ftp.credentials: Displayed and editable via native Xbox keyboard; 1..63 printable ASCII; changed credentials invalidate existing sessions
ftp.persistence: Worker flush/temp/rename plus exit flush; legacy enabled-only file upgraded, saved off respected before listening

audio_boundary.unregister: After feeder join, bounded queue drain and final silent-frame time
audio_boundary.scope: Lifecycle smoothing; original clips and event pitch/timing unchanged. Actual console static reduction requires listening on Xbox 360.

tests.sanitizers: ASan/UBSan/LSan pass: native profile adapter, public profile count, shared achievements, native achievements adapter, audio and FTP integration; FTP final rerun passes
tests.ftp: Real host ftplib transfers, credentials changes, restarts, legacy migration, invalid input, device counts, cancellation and shared navigation
xex_verification: 21 verified image pages; header/image/import digest chains valid
PASS: deliberate image mutation rejected: image digest mismatch at page 19

video_scope: Fresh final-renderer desktop GPU capture, 78 seconds. Profiles, achievements, FTP, storage and Guide/keyboard requests explicitly simulated. Native requests represented as notices, no fake Guide menu.

native_reference.inspection: 702 stock thunk0x92705194 has user/panes/flags; 708 thunk0x92706054 has user argument; Xenia Canary confirms achievement flags/tile types. Decoded stock executables are not published.

physical_validation: Needs Xbox 360 verification of real profile count/picture, Guide account/achievement targets, native keyboard/persisted FTP login, LAN/storage transfers and startup/exit audio listening. Desktop and host adapter tests cannot demonstrate these physical behaviors.
